services.purpose: Bootstraps the private Scrypted administrator; camera plugins, mDNS, hardware and NVR remain separate approvals.

acceptance.description: Inspect first-run state, checkpoint creation, verify the saved password, then privately save and read back the durable user token. The first owner's admin role is source-inferred, not independently read back; camera functionality remains unverified.
With separate camera credentials, plugin and network approvals, verify the selected camera stream. HomeKit mDNS, hardware, NVR storage and licensing are not configured by this bridge-only bootstrap.
Restart the exact owned project and reverify the saved administrator password, durable token and selected camera state.
